signal: FLEX Credit Union Technology announced multiple 2026 fintech partnerships including Plaid, QCash, Entrust, and SavvyMoney while serving 280+ credit unions

email.body1:
Hayden, saw FLEX stacked up partnerships with Plaid, QCash, Entrust, and SavvyMoney while serving 280-plus credit unions.

A wave of new integrations usually means more credit unions worth a conversation than a regional team can cover before interest cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for FLEX off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Hayden, quick follow-up for FLEX.

Each new partner story usually pulls the number up faster than the headcount you can add to chase it. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings FLEX needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Hayden, last bit of proof for FLEX.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FLEX's reply rate likely compares to other fintech teams selling to credit unions. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Hayden, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling credit-union pipeline without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out new partner integrations is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to FLEX either way.
